run_challenge_submission: run the script to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from prediction results
write_is2re_relaxations_from_traj: write IS2RE relaxation predictions from trajectory files in a directory to a compressed NPZ submission file
write_is2re_relaxations_hybrid: write IS2RE predictions from hybrid S2EF NPZ files containing force and energy model results
write_predictions_generic: write generic challenge predictions by prefixing all keys in an NPZ file with challenge_ and saving as NPZ
run_main_with_args: run the main function with argparse to create submission files for S2EF, IS2RE, or IS2RS tasks
